# Welcome to G7 Development

Premium FiveM resources, built with care. This documentation hub is the home for setup guides, configuration references, and integration notes for G7 Development scripts.

## Browse documentation

Browse **G7 Scripts** to find G7 Lean System and the rest of the resource guides.

> Documentation is version-specific. Always compare the guide with the resource version installed on your server.

## Need help?

When requesting support, include the resource version, framework, inventory, relevant console errors, and steps to reproduce the issue. Never share server keys or credentials.

title: G7 Lean System
description: Installation, inventory setup, configuration options, and in-game shop setup for G7 Lean System.
markdown:
# G7 Lean System — Installation

## Requirements

- `ox_lib`
- One framework: QBCore, Qbox or ESX
- One inventory: ox_inventory, qb-inventory, qs-inventory, or a custom adapter
- `ox_target` or `qb-target` (optional, only needed for the target option on placed cups)
- `g7_advanced_progressbar` (optional, any supported progress bar also works)

## Steps

1. Copy the `g7_leansystem` folder into your server's `resources` folder. Keep the folder name exactly `g7_leansystem`.
2. Add the items to your inventory (see the section for your inventory below).
3. Copy every PNG from `install/inventory/images/` into your inventory's item image folder.
4. Add the resource to `server.cfg`, after its dependencies and your inventory:

   ```cfg
   ensure ox_lib
   ensure qb-core            # or qbx_core / es_extended
   ensure ox_inventory       # or qb-inventory / qs-inventory
   ensure g7_leansystem
   ```

5. Restart the server and check the console. You should see the detected framework and inventory.
6. In game, use any G7 lean item, or press `F7` / type `/leanmenu`, to open the mixing lab.

## ox_inventory

1. Merge the entries from `install/inventory/items.lua` into `ox_inventory/data/items.lua`. Do not replace the whole file.
2. Copy the PNGs to `ox_inventory/web/images/`.
3. Keep `consume = 0` and the `export = 'g7_leansystem.useItem'` line on every G7 item.
4. Keep `g7_lean_bottle_filled`, `g7_lean_cup_soda` and `g7_lean_drink` non-stackable (`stack = false`).
5. Restart `ox_inventory`, then `g7_leansystem`.

## qb-inventory / Qbox

1. Merge the entries from `install/inventory/qb-items.lua` into `qb-core/shared/items.lua` (or your Qbox shared items file). Do not replace the whole table.
2. Copy the PNGs to your inventory's image folder (for example `qb-inventory/html/images/`).
3. Keep `unique = true` on `g7_lean_bottle_filled`, `g7_lean_cup_soda` and `g7_lean_drink`.
4. Restart the server.

## qs-inventory

Start with `install/inventory/qb-items.lua` and the same PNGs. If your qs-inventory version does not support the same add / remove / use-item exports, set `Config.Inventory = 'custom'` and fill in the functions below.

## Custom inventory

In `config.lua` set `Config.Inventory = 'custom'` and fill in `Config.CustomInventory`:

```lua
Config.CustomInventory = {
    count = function(source, item) end,                  -- return the item count
    remove = function(source, item, count, metadata) end, -- return true on success
    add = function(source, item, count, metadata) end,    -- keep metadata, return true on success
    registerUse = function(item, callback) end            -- callback(source, itemData)
}
```

## Config choices

Set these in `config.lua` if auto-detection is not right for your server:

```lua
Config.Framework = 'auto'   -- auto, qb, qbox, esx
Config.Inventory = 'auto'   -- auto, ox, qb, qs, custom
Config.Locale    = 'en'     -- en, fr, es
Config.ProgressBar.Provider = 'auto' -- auto, g7, qb, qbox, esx, ox_lib, custom
Config.Interaction.Target = 'auto'   -- auto, ox_target, qb-target, custom, none
Config.Interaction.Text3D = 'auto'   -- auto, always, never
```

If you run more than one inventory resource, set `Config.Inventory` to the one players actually use.

## Shops

Shops are built in game with `/leanadmin` (no file editing). Give your admins access in `server.cfg`:

```
add_ace group.admin g7lean.admin allow
```

(Framework groups and identifiers can also be listed in `Config.Admin`.)

1. Run `/leanadmin` and press **New shop**.
2. Name it, pick cash / bank / both, then **Place shopkeeper** (aim and left click) or **Where I stand**.
3. Choose a map icon, colour and size. **Preview** shows it on your minimap.
4. Switch on the items it sells and set each price, then **Save shop**.

Shops save to `data/store.json` and appear for everyone immediately. Back up or move shops by copying that file. The three example shops in `Config.Shop.Locations` are only created the first time the script starts.

Interaction uses ox_target or qb-target when running (`Config.Shop.Target`), otherwise an `E` prompt. Money works with QBCore, Qbox and ESX out of the box. For standalone with ox_inventory, cash is the `money` item (`Config.Shop.CashItem`). For anything else, fill in `Config.CustomMoney`.

markdown:
# G7 Black Market Phone — Installation

## Requirements
- OneSync
- `oxmysql`
- A framework (Qbox, QBCore or ESX) and a supported inventory
- `screenshot-basic` (optional, for Camera and Gallery apps)
- `g7_blackmarket` (optional, for shared rep and Contracts app)

## Step 1 — Add the resource
Drop `g7_blackmarket_phone` into your resources folder.

## Step 2 — Install the items and images
Everything is in `install/`. Use the row for your inventory and skip items you already have.

| Inventory | Item file | Images (copy into) |
|---|---|---|
| **g7_inventory** | `install/ox_inventory_g7_inventory_qbox.lua` → `g7_inventory/data/items.lua` | `install/images/ox/*` → `g7_inventory/web/images/` |
| **ox_inventory / Qbox** | `install/ox_inventory_g7_inventory_qbox.lua` → `ox_inventory/data/items.lua` | `install/images/ox/*` → `ox_inventory/web/images/` |
| **QBCore** (qb / ps / lj / codem / core) | `install/qb-core_shared_items.lua` → `qb-core/shared/items.lua` | `install/images/qb/*` → your inventory image folder |
| **qs-inventory** | `install/qs-inventory_items.lua` → `qs-inventory/shared/items.lua` | `install/images/qb/*` → `qs-inventory/html/images/` |
| **ESX** (default inventory) | Run `install/esx_items.sql` | `install/images/qb/*` → your inventory image folder |

The burner phone item is `blackmarket_phone`. On ox/g7 its entry already calls `g7_blackmarket_phone.usePhone`; on QB/ESX it is registered as usable automatically.

## Step 3 — server.cfg
```cfg
ensure oxmysql
# your framework + inventory here
ensure screenshot-basic       # optional, for the camera
ensure g7_blackmarket         # optional, must start BEFORE the phone
ensure g7_blackmarket_phone

add_ace group.admin g7bmphone.admin allow
```

## Step 4 — Database
Nothing to do. Tables are created automatically on first start.

## Step 5 — Configure
- **Logs:** set `Config.Logs.service` to `discord` (with a webhook) or `fivemanage` (with an API key).
- **Drop locations:** 35 spots are preconfigured in `Config.DropLocations`. Test them on your map and move any that clash with MLOs. Add `ped = vector4(...)` to place a dealer yourself.
- **Phone look:** `Config.Phone.ui` (theme defaults to `'frost'`). Set `allowCustomize = false` to stop players changing wallpaper, frame color and size.
- **Custom phone prop (optional):** stream your prop, set `Config.Phone.prop`, then adjust `bone`, `offset` and `rotation`.
- **Admin groups:** add groups to `Config.Admin.groups` if you don't use the ACE above.
- **Item names:** config uses ox/g7 names (`WEAPON_PISTOL`, `ammo-9`, `armour`). QB-style inventories are translated automatically. Add renames in `Config.ItemAliases`.

## Step 6 — Test
1. Restart the server.
2. Give yourself a `blackmarket_phone` and use it.
3. Run `/bmphoneadmin` to check the admin app opens.

---

Store: https://g7-development.tebex.io/ · Discord: https://discord.gg/P6XQ4N6M95

Every G7 script auto-detects its framework (Qbox, QBCore, ESX) and inventory (g7_inventory first, then ox_inventory, qs-inventory, qb/ps/lj, ESX default). Always ensure G7 scripts **after** your framework, inventory and `oxmysql`.

# G7 Black Market — Installation

## Requirements
- `oxmysql`
- A framework (Qbox, QBCore, ESX, or custom) and a supported inventory
- `ox_lib` (optional: notifications, progress bars and heist hack minigame)
- `ox_target` or `qb-target` (optional; `[E]` prompts are used otherwise)

## Step 1 — Add the resource
Drop `g7_blackmarket` into your resources folder.

## Step 2 — Install the items and images
Everything is in `install/`. Use the row for your inventory and skip items you already have.

| Inventory | Item file | Images (copy into) |
|---|---|---|
| **g7_inventory** | `install/ox_inventory_g7_inventory_qbox.lua` → `g7_inventory/data/items.lua` | `install/images/ox/*` → `g7_inventory/web/images/` |
| **ox_inventory / Qbox** | `install/ox_inventory_g7_inventory_qbox.lua` → `ox_inventory/data/items.lua` | `install/images/ox/*` → `ox_inventory/web/images/` |
| **QBCore** (qb / ps / lj / codem / core) | `install/qb-core_shared_items.lua` → `qb-core/shared/items.lua` | `install/images/qb/*` → your inventory image folder |
| **qs-inventory** | `install/qs-inventory_items.lua` → `qs-inventory/shared/items.lua` | `install/images/qb/*` → `qs-inventory/html/images/` |
| **ESX** (default inventory) | Run `install/esx_items.sql` | `install/images/qb/*` → your inventory image folder |

## Step 3 — Add your logo
Replace `html/g7.png` with your own G7 logo.

## Step 4 — server.cfg
```cfg
ensure oxmysql
# your framework + inventory here
ensure g7_blackmarket
ensure g7_blackmarket_phone  # optional, must start AFTER g7_blackmarket
```

## Step 5 — Database
Nothing to do. Tables are created automatically on first start.

## Step 6 — Configure
- **Theme:** `Config.Theme.preset` (`'frost'` default, `'g7'`, `'toxic'`, `'ember'`, `'gold'`, `'mono'` or `'custom'`)
- **Heist sites:** check `Config.HeistLocations` on your map
- **Crews:** `Config.Crews` (default: $25k, rank 2)
- **Laundering:** `Config.Laundering`
- **Market events:** `Config.MarketEvents`
- **Weekly prizes:** `Config.WeeklyPrizes` (default Monday 18:00 server time)
- **Serial tracing:** `Config.Serials.reveal` (`name`, `partial` or `none`)
- **Trusted resources:** list resources allowed to open the UI remotely in `Config.RemoteOpenResources` (add `g7_blackmarket_phone` if used)
- **Item names:** QB-style names are translated automatically; add renames in `Config.ItemAliases`
- **Custom framework:** set `Config.Framework = 'custom'` and fill in the `Custom` table in `bridge/server.lua`

## Step 7 — Test
1. Restart the server and visit a mission giver.
2. As admin: `/bmsetrep [id] [amount]` to test rank unlocks, and `/bmevent sale` to test a market event.
3. As police: buy a weapon and run `/bmtrace [serial]`.

---

# G7 Drug Sales + Trap Phone — Installation

## Requirements
- A framework: Qbox, QBCore or ESX
- A supported inventory: g7_inventory, ox_inventory, qs-inventory, qb-inventory (ps / lj)
- A target (optional): `ox_target` or `qb-target`; built-in 3D text is used otherwise
- `oxmysql` (optional; KVP is used without SQL)
- **No ox_lib needed**

## Step 1 — Add the resources
Put **both** `g7_drugsales` and `g7_trapphone` in your resources folder.

## Step 2 — Install the items and image
1. Add the items from `install/items/` for your inventory.
2. Copy the image from `install/images/` into your inventory image folder.

## Step 3 — Add your logo
Replace `html/img/g7.png` with your G7 logo.

## Step 4 — server.cfg
Start these after your framework, inventory and target. `g7_trapphone` goes first:
```cfg
ensure g7_trapphone
ensure g7_drugsales
```

## Step 5 — Database
Nothing to do. With oxmysql the table is created automatically; without it, KVP is used.

## Step 6 — Configure (`config.lua`)
- **Drugs:** add entries to `Config.Drugs` (item name as key), or register them from another resource with `exports.g7_drugsales:RegisterDrug(...)`
- **Payout:** `Config.Payout.Type` = `'item'` (default `black_money`), `'account'` or `'markedbills'`
- **Police:** minimum cops, price bonus per cop, and dispatch (ps-dispatch, cd_dispatch, qs-dispatch, built-in or custom)
- **Zones:** hotspots and blacklisted zones (PD, hospital)
- **Locations:** use `/g7dscoords` in game to copy a `vec4(...)` for new spots
- **Phone prop (optional):** stream your own model in `g7_trapphone`

## Step 7 — Test
1. Restart the server.
2. Give yourself a drug item from your config.
3. Run `/drugphone` to open the phone, then `/selldrugs` to start corner selling.

---

title: G7 Inventory
description: Install G7 Inventory and migrate from an existing inventory system.
markdown:
# G7 Inventory — Installation

G7 Inventory is a drop-in replacement for **ox_inventory**. Scripts that use `exports.ox_inventory`, listen to `ox_inventory:*` events or check whether `ox_inventory` is started keep working without changes. Your framework is detected automatically.

**Supported frameworks:** Qbox · ESX Legacy · QBCore · ox_core · ND_Core · Standalone

---

## Requirements

| Resource | Notes |
|---|---|
| [ox_lib](https://github.com/overextended/ox_lib) | Latest release |
| [oxmysql](https://github.com/overextended/oxmysql) | Latest release |
| OneSync | Legacy or Infinity |
| [ox_target](https://github.com/overextended/ox_target) | Optional, only if you want target interactions |

---

## 1. Remove your old inventory

G7 Inventory registers itself as `ox_inventory`, so **it can't run alongside another inventory**.

- **From ox_inventory:** stop it and remove it from your server (or move it out of your resources folder). Your existing items, stashes, trunks and gloveboxes are kept. G7 uses the same database layout, so nothing needs converting.
- **From qb-inventory, ps-inventory or lj-inventory:** remove the inventory resource, then follow [Moving over from another inventory](#5-moving-over-from-another-inventory) after the first start.
- **From the default ESX inventory:** nothing to remove. Follow [Moving over from another inventory](#5-moving-over-from-another-inventory) after the first start.

> **Back up your database before installing.** Any inventory change is worth a backup first.

---

## 2. Add the resource

1. Download `g7_inventory` and extract it into your resources folder.
2. Keep the folder name **`g7_inventory`**. It's used for image paths and exports.

```
resources/
└── [inventory]/
    └── g7_inventory/
        ├── client/
        ├── data/
        ├── locales/
        ├── server/
        ├── shared/
        ├── sql/
        ├── web/
        ├── config.lua
        └── fxmanifest.lua
```

---

## 3. Update server.cfg

Start G7 Inventory **after** oxmysql, ox_lib and your framework, and **before** any script that uses the inventory.

```cfg
ensure oxmysql
ensure ox_lib
ensure qbx_core          # or es_extended / qb-core / ox_core / ND_Core
ensure g7_inventory

# everything that uses the inventory goes below
ensure ox_target
ensure [jobs]
ensure [scripts]
```

> **Remove this line if you have it.** Most servers that ran ox_inventory have:
> ```cfg
> setr inventory:imagepath "nui://ox_inventory/web/images"
> ```
> G7 redirects it automatically, but it's cleaner to delete it or point it at G7:
> ```cfg
> setr inventory:imagepath "nui://g7_inventory/web/images"
> ```

---

## 4. Start the server

On first start, G7 creates the tables and columns it needs:

| Table / column | Used for |
|---|---|
| `inventory` column on your framework's player table | Player inventories |
| `ox_inventory` | Stashes |
| `glovebox` / `trunk` columns on your framework's vehicle table | Vehicle storage |
| `g7_progression` | Levels, XP, skills and daily missions |
| `g7_players` | Player inventories, **standalone servers only** |

If your database user can't create tables, run `sql/install.sql` by hand instead.

When everything is working, the server console shows:

```
[g7_inventory] ready - framework: qbx, 507 items, ox_inventory API v2.48 compatible
```

Check that the framework named there is the one you use. To force a different one, see [Framework setup](#framework-setup).

---

## 5. Moving over from another inventory

Skip this step if you came from **ox_inventory**: your data already works.

Player inventories in the old qb-inventory and ESX formats are **converted automatically** the first time each player joins. The commands below convert everything at once, and they're **required** for qb-inventory stashes and ESX weapon loadouts.

Run the matching command **once**, from the **server console** (txAdmin live console or the server window, not in game), while no players are online:

| Coming from | Command | What it converts |
|---|---|---|
| qb-inventory / ps / lj | `g7convert qb` | All player inventories (`amount` / `info` format) |
| qb-inventory / ps / lj | `g7convert qbstashes` | Stashes, trunks and gloveboxes (**required**) |
| ESX (default inventory) | `g7convert esx` | Player inventories and weapon loadouts (**required** for loadouts) |

Wait for the console to print `conversion finished - restart the server`, then restart.

### Item lists

G7 reads items from `data/items.lua` and weapons from `data/weapons.lua`, both in **ox_inventory format**. You can paste an existing ox `items.lua` straight in.

QBCore and ESX servers can also keep their framework item lists. With this setting on, items from `QBCore.Shared.Items` or the ESX `items` table that aren't in `data/items.lua` are added automatically:

```lua
-- config.lua
Config.ImportFrameworkItems = true
```

> **Items that don't exist are never deleted.** If a player has an item that isn't in your item list, it stays saved and the console shows `unknown item "name" ... kept in storage`. Add the item to `data/items.lua` and it appears again for the player.

---

## Framework setup

The framework is detected in this order: **Qbox → ESX → QBCore → ox_core → ND_Core → Standalone**.

To force one, set it in `server.cfg`:

```cfg
setr inventory:framework "qbx"     # qbx | esx | qb | ox | nd | standalone
```

### Qbox
Works out of the box. Money is kept in sync with Qbox's cash account.

> Don't add `provide 'qb-inventory'` on Qbox. Qbox refuses to save players while it thinks qb-inventory is running.

### ESX Legacy
Works out of the box. G7 uses ESX's built-in ox_inventory support, so nothing needs changing in ESX. `money` and `black_money` are handled as account items.

### QBCore
Works out of the box. QBCore item functions (`Player.Functions.AddItem`, `RemoveItem`, `HasItem`…) and the `qb-inventory`, `ps-inventory` and `lj-inventory` exports are bridged to G7.

If a script refuses to work because it checks whether `qb-inventory` is **started**, open `fxmanifest.lua` and uncomment:

```lua
-- provide 'qb-inventory'
```

**QBCore only.** Never do this on Qbox.

### ox_core / ND_Core
Supported through their existing ox_inventory integration. No extra steps.

### Standalone
Players are identified by their FiveM license and stored in the `g7_players` table. Permission groups come from ACE:

```cfg
add_ace group.admin g7.group.admin allow
add_ace group.police g7.group.police allow
```

---

## Item images

Item images go in `web/images/` as **`<item name>.png`**, for example `water.png` or `WEAPON_PISTOL.png`.

- Use lowercase `.png` extensions. Linux servers treat `.PNG` and `.png` as different files.
- An item can use a different image with `client = { image = 'other_name.png' }` in its definition.
- To host images on a website instead:
  ```cfg
  setr inventory:imagepath "https://cdn.example.com/items"
  ```
  If an image can't be loaded from there, G7 falls back to its own `web/images` folder.

---

## Keybinds

| Default key | Action |
|---|---|
| `F2` | Open inventory (also opens a nearby drop, or the trunk when you're behind an unlocked vehicle) |
| `K` | Open trunk, glovebox, dumpster or stash |
| `TAB` | Show the hotbar |
| `1` – `5` | Use fast slots |
| `Z` (hold) | Quick wheel |
| `R` | Reload |

Players can rebind these in **Settings → Key Bindings → FiveM**. To change the defaults for everyone:

```cfg
setr inventory:keys ["F2", "K", "TAB"]    # inventory, secondary, hotbar
```

---

## Common server.cfg options

All ox_inventory `inventory:*` convars work. The most used ones:

```cfg
setr inventory:slots 50               # player slots
setr inventory:weight 30000           # player max weight, in grams
setr inventory:target false           # true = use ox_target for stashes, shops, benches
setr inventory:police ["police", "sheriff"]
setr inventory:screenblur true
setr inventory:weaponanims true
setr inventory:droplifetime 15        # minutes before dropped bags disappear (0 = never)
set  inventory:webhook "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."   # logs
set  inventory:loglevel 1             # 0 off, 1 important, 2 everything
```

### Player card photos (optional)

The player card can show a Discord or Steam profile picture. Put the keys in `server.cfg` with **`set`**, never `setr` (which would send them to every player) and never in a Lua file:

```cfg
set g7:discordToken "your-bot-token"
set g7:steamApiKey  "your-steam-web-api-key"
```

---

## Configuration

Everything else lives in **`config.lua`**: themes, features, shops, drops, backpacks, weapons on back, encumbrance, progression and more. Any feature can be switched off under `Config.Features`.

Data files in `data/` use the same format as ox_inventory:

| File | Contains |
|---|---|
| `items.lua` | Items |
| `weapons.lua` | Weapons, attachments, tints and ammo |
| `shops.lua` | Shops and vending machines |
| `stashes.lua` | Stashes and lockers |
| `crafting.lua` | Crafting benches and recipes |
| `evidence.lua` | Police evidence lockers |
| `licenses.lua` | Purchasable licences |
| `vehicles.lua` | Trunk and glovebox sizes |
| `animations.lua` | Item use animations |
| `skills.lua` / `missions.lua` | Progression skills and daily missions |

Pasted ox data files that use ox's `shared` table (for example `groups = shared.police`) work without editing.

---

## Check your installation

1. Join the server and press **F2**. Your inventory opens with your items.
2. Run `/giveitem <your id> water 5` and check the water appears.
3. Drop an item, then press **F2** next to the bag to pick it up.
4. Open a vehicle trunk with **K** while standing behind it.
5. Run `/saveinv`. The console prints `saved N inventories`.

### Admin commands

Admin commands need `group.admin`. `/trade` is for every player, and `/clearevidence` is for police bosses.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/giveitem [id] [item] [count]` | Give an item (`/additem` works too) |
| `/removeitem [id] [item] [count]` | Remove an item |
| `/setitem [id] [item] [count]` | Set the exact amount of an item |
| `/viewinv [id]` | Look at a player's inventory |
| `/clearinv [id]` | Wipe a player's inventory |
| `/takeinv [id]` | Confiscate a player's inventory |
| `/restoreinv [id]` | Give a confiscated inventory back |
| `/saveinv` | Save all inventories now |
| `/addxp [id] [amount]` | Give progression XP |
| `/g7items` | Show how many items are loaded |
| `/trade [id]` | Ask a nearby player to trade (all players) |
| `/clearevidence [locker]` | Empty an evidence locker (police bosses) |

---

## Troubleshooting

**Images are missing or faded**
Check `server.cfg` for an `inventory:imagepath` line pointing at another resource, and remove it. Make sure each image is named exactly like the item, with a lowercase `.png` extension.

**`attempt to index a nil value (global 'shared')` on startup**
You're running a version older than 1.1.0. Update G7 Inventory.

**The console shows a different framework than yours**
Make sure your framework starts **before** `g7_inventory` in `server.cfg`, or force it with `setr inventory:framework`.

**`could not read inventory of ...` in the console**
G7 couldn't reach your database when the player joined. It retries 3 times. If that fails, the inventory stays read-only for that session so nothing gets overwritten. Check that oxmysql is connected, then ask the player to reconnect.

**A QBCore script says the inventory isn't started**
Uncomment `provide 'qb-inventory'` in `fxmanifest.lua` (QBCore only).

**Another inventory is still running**
Only one inventory can run. Remove ox_inventory, qb-inventory, ps-inventory or lj-inventory from your resources and `server.cfg`.

---

## Updating

1. Back up `config.lua` and anything you changed in `data/`.
2. Replace the whole `g7_inventory` folder, so the built UI files in `web/build` are replaced too.
3. Put your `config.lua` and `data/` files back, then compare them with the new versions for any new settings. The changelog lists them.
4. Restart the server.

markdown:
# G7 Vape System — Installation This guide takes you from download to a working vape system on your server. It takes about 10 minutes. ## Requirements | Requirement | Notes | |---|---| | **OneSync** | Must be enabled on your server. | | **[ox_lib](https://github.com/overextended/ox_lib)** | Required. Start it before the vape system. | | **Framework** | QBox, QBCore, ESX, or standalone. Detected automatically. | | **Inventory** | ox_inventory, qb-inventory, ps-inventory, lj-inventory, or a custom inventory. Detected automatically. | | **Vape props** | The `g7devvape` (vape pen) and `g7vapejuice` (juice bottle) prop resources. | | **Target (optional)** | ox_target or qb-target for the shops. Without one, a built-in "Press E" prompt is used. | No SQL is needed. Shops, flavour edits and the UI theme are saved in a JSON file inside the resource. --- ## Step 1: Add the resource 1. Download `g7_vapesystem` from your Keymaster / Tebex purchase. 2. Unzip it and place the `g7_vapesystem` folder in your server's `resources` folder. > **Important:** do not rename the folder. It must stay `g7_vapesystem`. --- ## Step 2: Start order in `server.cfg` `ox_lib` and the prop resources must start **before** the vape system: ```cfg ensure ox_lib ensure g7devvape # vape pen prop ensure g7vapejuice # vape juice prop ensure g7_vapesystem ``` If you use a framework, inventory or target resource, it should also start before `g7_vapesystem`. --- ## Step 3: Add the items The script uses three items: | Item | What it is | |---|---| | `g7_devvape` | The vape pen. Its tank, flavour, battery and condition are saved on the item. | | `g7_vapejuice` | One item for **every** flavour of juice. The flavour and how much is left are saved on the item. | | `g7_vapecharger` | The vape charger. Use it to charge a vape. | Pick your inventory below. ### ox_inventory (QBox, ESX, or standalone) Open `ox_inventory/data/items.lua` and paste this inside the table: ```lua ['g7_devvape'] = { label = 'Vape Pen', weight = 1, stack = false, close = true, consume = 0, description = 'Refillable pen', server = { export = 'g7_vapesystem.g7UseItem' }, }, ['g7_vapejuice'] = { label = 'Vape Refill', weight = 1, stack = false, close = true, consume = 0, description = 'Use it to open the refill station.', server = { export = 'g7_vapesystem.g7UseItem' }, }, ['g7_vapecharger'] = { label = 'Vape Charger', weight = 1, stack = true, close = true, consume = 0, description = 'USB-C fast charger. Use it to charge your vape.', server = { export = 'g7_vapesystem.g7UseItem' }, }, ``` > **Note:** the vape and juice items must have `stack = false`. Each one carries its own data (tank level, battery, flavour), so they can't stack. ### qb-inventory, ps-inventory or lj-inventory (QBCore) Open `qb-core/shared/items.lua` and paste this inside the table: ```lua g7_devvape = { name = 'g7_devvape', label = 'Vape Pen', weight = 1, type = 'item', image = 'g7_devvape.png', unique = true, useable = true, shouldClose = true, description = 'Refillable pen' }, g7_vapejuice = { name = 'g7_vapejuice', label = 'Vape Refill', weight = 1, type = 'item', image = 'g7_vapejuice.png', unique = true, useable = true, shouldClose = true, description = 'Use it to open the refill station.' }, g7_vapecharger = { name = 'g7_vapecharger', label = 'Vape Charger', weight = 1, type = 'item', image = 'g7_vapecharger.png', unique = false, useable = true, shouldClose = true, description = 'USB-C fast charger. Use it to charge your vape.' }, ```
Using an older QBCore with the ['name'] = { ... } style? ```lua ['g7_devvape'] = { ['name'] = 'g7_devvape', ['label'] = 'Vape Pen', ['weight'] = 1, ['type'] = 'item', ['image'] = 'g7_devvape.png', ['unique'] = true, ['useable'] = true, ['shouldClose'] = true, ['description'] = 'Refillable pen.' }, ['g7_vapejuice'] = { ['name'] = 'g7_vapejuice', ['label'] = 'Vape Refill', ['weight'] = 1, ['type'] = 'item', ['image'] = 'g7_vapejuice.png', ['unique'] = true, ['useable'] = true, ['shouldClose'] = true, ['description'] = 'Opens the refill station.' }, ['g7_vapecharger'] = { ['name'] = 'g7_vapecharger', ['label'] = 'Vape Charger', ['weight'] = 1, ['type'] = 'item', ['image'] = 'g7_vapecharger.png', ['unique'] = false, ['useable'] = true, ['shouldClose'] = true, ['description'] = 'Charges your vape.' }, ```
### Custom inventory 1. In `config.lua`, set: ```lua Config.Inventory = 'custom' Config.CustomInventory.resource = 'your_inventory' ``` 2. Your inventory must provide these **server exports**. The names can be changed in `Config.CustomInventory.exports`. Every item is a table `{ name, count, metadata, slot }`, metadata must be saved per slot, and the vape and juice items must not stack. | Export | Arguments | Returns | |---|---|---| | `GetItemBySlot` | `(src, slot)` | the item, or `nil` | | `GetItemsByName` | `(src, name)` | a list of items | | `SetMetadata` | `(src, slot, metadata)` | `true` / `false` | | `AddItem` | `(src, name, count, metadata)` | `true` / `false` | | `RemoveItem` | `(src, name, count, slot)` | `true` / `false` | | `CanCarryItem` | `(src, name, count)` | `true` / `false` | 3. When a player uses `g7_devvape`, `g7_vapejuice` or `g7_vapecharger`, call: ```lua exports.g7_vapesystem:UseItem(source, itemName, slot) ``` --- ## Step 4: Add the item images Copy **every** image from `g7_vapesystem/install/images/` into your inventory's image folder: | Inventory | Image folder | |---|---| | ox_inventory | `ox_inventory/web/images/` | | qb-inventory | `qb-inventory/html/images/` | | ps / lj-inventory | the `html/images/` folder of that inventory | The images are: ```text g7_devvape.png g7_vapecharger.png g7_vapejuice.png g7_vapejuice_beastice.png g7_vapejuice_coolmint.png g7_vapejuice_mangofreeze.png g7_vapejuice_pinklemonade.png g7_vapejuice_purplehaze.png g7_vapejuice_unflavoured.png g7_vapejuice_watermelonice.png ``` > **Tip:** on ox_inventory every flavour shows its own bottle picture. Other inventories show `g7_vapejuice.png` for all flavours. --- ## Step 5: Admin permissions Admins can open `/vapeadmin` and use the admin tools. Add this to `server.cfg`, and change `group.admin` to your own admin group if it's different: ```cfg add_ace group.admin g7vape.admin allow ``` Framework groups `admin`, `god` and `superadmin` are also allowed automatically. You can change those groups, or add single players by license or Discord ID, in `Config.Admin` in `config.lua`: ```lua Config.Admin = { ace = 'g7vape.admin', groups = { 'admin', 'god', 'superadmin' }, identifiers = { 'license:xxxxxxxx', 'discord:xxxxxxxx' }, } ``` --- ## Step 6: Full server restart Do a **full server restart** the first time. Restarting just the resource is not enough. > **Why:** the hold animation (`g7vapehold.ycd`) and the smoke effect (`g7smokecustom.ypt`) are streamed files, and FiveM only loads new streamed files on a full restart. --- ## Step 7: Test it A test shop called **Vape Shop** is created at Legion Square the first time the script starts. You can edit or delete it in `/vapeadmin`. You can also give yourself items. These commands work in game for admins and in the server console: ```text /g7givevape g7_devvape 3 a vape with 3 ml of juice in it /g7givevape beastice a full bottle of Beast Ice /g7givevape charger a vape charger ``` Then check: - [ ] Use the vape: it appears in your hand and the side HUD shows the tank, flavour, battery and condition. - [ ] Hold **E** to hit it, let go to exhale: a cloud in the flavour's colour comes out. - [ ] Use the bottle: the refill station opens. - [ ] Use the charger: the charge station opens. - [ ] Walk up to the shopkeeper: the shop opens. --- ## Configuration Everything can be changed in `config.lua`. The most common settings: | Setting | What it changes | |---|---| | `Config.Framework` | `'auto'`, or force `'qbx'`, `'qb'`, `'esx'` or `'standalone'`. | | `Config.Inventory` | `'auto'`, or force `'ox'`, `'qb'` or `'custom'`. | | `Config.Notify` | `'ox_lib'`, `'nui'`, `'qb'`, `'esx'` or `'custom'`. | | `Config.Devices` | Vape models: tank size, how fast they use juice and battery, price. | | `Config.Flavors` | Flavour names, colours, pictures and smoke colours. | | `Config.Battery` | Battery drain per hit and while the vape is held out. | | `Config.Durability` | How fast vapes wear out and break. | | `Config.Charger` | Charging speed, price, and whether the charger is used up. | | `Config.Bubbles` | The speech bubble lines for each flavour, and how often they show. | | `Config.Shops` | Shop interaction (`ox_target`, `qb-target` or prompt), default shopkeeper, buy limits. | | `Config.Controls` | The hit and put-away keys, and the `/vape` command. | | `Config.Commands` | The names of every admin command. | | `Config.Theme` | The UI colours. Admins can also change these live in `/vapeadmin`. | Shops, prices, flavour edits and the theme you change in `/vapeadmin` save to `data/store.json` and apply to everyone right away, with no restart. --- ## Troubleshooting
Using an item does nothing The items weren't added, or were added to the wrong inventory. Redo [Step 3](#step-3-add-the-items) and restart. On ox_inventory, check that each item has `server = { export = 'g7_vapesystem.g7UseItem' }`.
No vape in my hand, or a stock vape shows instead of mine The `g7devvape` prop resource isn't started, or it starts after `g7_vapesystem`. Fix the order in [Step 2](#step-2-start-order-in-servercfg) and do a full restart.
The vape is too big or too small in the hand Keep the grip `scale` at `1.0` in `Config.Grips`. Any other value makes the vape trail behind the hand when you walk. Resize the model itself in Blender or CodeWalker instead. Admins can line up the position with `/vapegrip`.
No smoke when I exhale Do a full server restart. If the F8 console says `particle asset g7smokecustom did not load`, check that `stream/g7smokecustom.ypt` is in the resource. An empty tank or a dead battery also makes no smoke.
Item pictures are blank The images from `install/images/` weren't copied into your inventory's image folder. See [Step 4](#step-4-add-the-item-images).
I can't open /vapeadmin Add the `add_ace` line from [Step 5](#step-5-admin-permissions), or add your license or Discord ID to `Config.Admin.identifiers`.
"You are too far from the counter" in the shop Stand closer to the shopkeeper. The distance is set by `Config.Shops.distance`.
--- Need more help? Open a ticket in the **G7 Development** Discord.

title: G7 Reports V2
description: Install G7 Reports V2 and configure staff permissions.
markdown:
# G7 Reports V2 — Installation

G7 Reports is a report and ticket system for FiveM. Players send reports and chat with staff, and staff manage everything from a dashboard. This guide takes about five minutes.

## Requirements

| Requirement | Notes |
|---|---|
| FiveM server | Any recent artifact with Lua 5.4 support |
| [oxmysql](https://github.com/overextended/oxmysql) | Required. Used for the database |
| Framework | **ESX**, **QBCore**, **Qbox** or standalone. Detected automatically |

No other dependencies are needed. Fonts and icons are bundled, so the UI works without an internet connection.

## 1. Add the resource

1. Download and extract the resource.
2. Place the `g7-reports` folder in your server's `resources` directory.
3. **Keep the folder name exactly `g7-reports`.**

## 2. Edit `server.cfg`

Make sure `oxmysql` and your framework start **before** G7 Reports:

```cfg
ensure oxmysql
ensure es_extended      # or qb-core / qbx_core
ensure g7-reports
```

## 3. Give your staff access

Staff can open the panel with `/reports`. Access is granted if **any** of the following is true:

- the player has the ACE permission `g7-reports.staff`
- the player belongs to an ACE group listed in `Config.StaffGroups`
- the player has a matching framework group (ESX group, QBCore / Qbox permission)

### Recommended: permissions in `server.cfg`

Add this to your `server.cfg`:

```cfg
# Everyone in the admin group can use /reports
add_ace group.admin g7-reports.staff allow
add_ace group.mod   g7-reports.staff allow
```

To give a single person access, add their identifier to a group, or grant the permission directly:

```cfg
add_principal identifier.license:xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx group.admin

# or, for one person only:
add_ace identifier.license:xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx g7-reports.staff allow
```

> **Tip:** If you already use ESX groups or QBCore permissions, you don't need any ACE lines. Anyone whose group is in `Config.StaffGroups` (`admin`, `superadmin`, `god`, `mod`, `moderator` by default) already has access.

## 4. Start the server

On first start the script creates its database tables automatically. You should see this in the console:

```
[g7-reports] Database ready.
[g7-reports] V2 started — framework: esx
```

No SQL file needs to be imported. The tables created are `g7_reports` and `g7_reports_messages`.

## Commands

| Command | Who | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/report` | Everyone | Create a report, follow your reports, chat with staff, rate the result |
| `/reports` | Staff | Dashboard, all reports, claim, close, reopen, teleport, bring, return, spectate, private notes, settings |

Command names can be changed in `Config.Commands`. Optional keybinds are available in `Config.Keybinds`. The spectate exit key defaults to **F4**.

## Configuration

Everything is in `config/config.lua`.

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Config.Framework` | `'auto'` | `'auto'`, `'esx'`, `'qbcore'`, `'qbox'` or `'standalone'` |
| `Config.Locale` | `'en'` | `'en'` or `'pt'` |
| `Config.Commands` | `report` / `reports` | Player and staff command names |
| `Config.Keybinds` | all off, spectate `F4` | Optional keys to open the panels |
| `Config.StaffGroups` | `admin, superadmin, god, mod, moderator` | Groups that count as staff |
| `Config.AcePermission` | `'g7-reports.staff'` | ACE permission that grants staff access |
| `Config.Cooldown` | 60 s, max 3 open | Anti-spam: time between reports, open reports per player, chat delay |
| `Config.Categories` | 7 categories | Report categories, each with an icon, colour and priority |
| `Config.Priorities` | low to critical | Priority labels and colours |
| `Config.Limits` | title 5-80, description 10-1000 | Text length limits |
| `Config.QuickReplies` | 5 replies | Canned replies shown to staff above the chat box |
| `Config.Options` | see file | Toggle teleport, bring, return, spectate, ratings, page size and auto-close |
| `Config.Notify` | 5 s, sound on, top-right | Default notification behaviour |
| `Config.Discord` | disabled | Webhook logging for new, claimed, closed and rated reports |

### Discord logging

```lua
Config.Discord = {
    Enabled = true,
    Webhook = 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...',
    BotName = 'G7 Reports',
    Avatar  = '',
    Events  = { NewReport = true, Claimed = true, Closed = true, Rated = true },
}
```

### Adding a category

```lua
{ id = 'exploit', label = 'Exploit', icon = 'bug', color = '#ffd166', priority = 'high' },
```

Then add the translated name to each file in `locales/`:

```lua
cat_exploit = 'Exploit',
```

Available icons: `flag`, `shield`, `crosshair`, `bug`, `gavel`, `user`, `life-buoy`, `message`, `car`, `help`.

### Translations

All text lives in `locales/en.lua` and `locales/pt.lua`. To add a language, copy `en.lua`, rename it (for example `es.lua`), change the table key to `Locales['es']`, translate the values, and set `Config.Locale = 'es'`.

## Customising notifications and permissions in code

`editable/exports.lua` lets you plug G7 Reports into the rest of your server without touching the core files:

- `G7.Notify(...)` - use ox_lib, esx_notify or any notification system
- `G7.IsStaff(src)` - your own staff check (return `true`, `false`, or `nil` for the default logic)
- `G7.OnEvent(event, data)` - runs on `created`, `claimed`, `unclaimed`, `closed`, `reopened` and `rated`

## Troubleshooting

**`/reports` says I don't have permission**
Check that your ACE line is in `server.cfg`, that you restarted the server (or ran `refresh` then `restart g7-reports`), and that the group name matches.

**Database errors on start**
Make sure `oxmysql` starts before `g7-reports` and that its connection string is correct.

**The panel doesn't open or looks unstyled**
Confirm the folder is named `g7-reports` and that the `files { ... }` block in `fxmanifest.lua` is unchanged. Press F8 in game to check for NUI errors.

**Toast notifications use the default position**
Staff can change position, sound and duration in the panel under **Settings**. These are saved to `g7_settings.json` in the resource folder, so the server needs write access to it.

**Spectate says the player is offline**
The reporter must be online and streamed in. Spectate waits up to 5 seconds for their character to load.

## Updating

1. Back up `config/config.lua` and `g7_settings.json`.
2. Replace the resource folder with the new version.
3. Restore your config and settings files.
4. Restart the resource with `restart g7-reports`.

Database tables are preserved between updates.

## Support

If you need help, contact us through our support channel.

title: G7 Admin Pockets
description: Install G7 Admin Pockets and configure admin permissions.
markdown:
# G7 Admin Pockets — Installation

**G7 Admin Pockets** lets admins give players more carry weight in-game. Everything is saved to the database and can be revoked at any time. Follow the steps below to get it running in a few minutes.

---

## Requirements

| Resource | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| [oxmysql](https://github.com/overextended/oxmysql) | ✅ Yes | Database |
| Framework | ✅ Yes | QBCore, Qbox or ESX (auto-detected) |
| Inventory | ✅ Yes | g7_inventory (default), ox_inventory or qs-inventory |
| [ox_lib](https://github.com/overextended/ox_lib) | Optional | Only needed if `Config.Notify = 'ox_lib'` (the default) |

---

## Step 1: Add the resource

1. Download `g7_adminpockets` after purchasing it on [Tebex](https://g7-development.tebex.io/).
2. Unzip it and place the `g7_adminpockets` folder in your `resources` folder.

> ⚠️ Do not rename the folder. It must stay `g7_adminpockets`.

---

## Step 2: server.cfg

Start the script **after** oxmysql, your framework and your inventory:

```cfg
ensure oxmysql
ensure ox_lib
ensure qbx_core          # or qb-core / es_extended
ensure g7_inventory      # or ox_inventory / qs-inventory

ensure g7_adminpockets
```

---

## Step 3: Permissions

Add these lines to your `server.cfg` so your staff can open the panel:

```cfg
# Can open /adminpocket and give / revoke pocket space
add_ace group.admin g7_adminpockets.admin allow

# Can also manage the in-game admin whitelist
add_ace group.god g7_adminpockets.owner allow
```

A player can open the panel if **any** of these are true:

- They have the `g7_adminpockets.admin` ACE.
- Their framework group is listed in `Config.AdminGroups` (`god`, `admin`, `superadmin` by default).
- An owner added them in the **Admins** tab of the panel.

---

## Step 4: Database

Nothing to do. The tables are created automatically the first time the script starts.

If you prefer to run it yourself, import `sql/install.sql` into your database. It creates:

| Table | Stores |
|---|---|
| `g7_adminpockets_grants` | Every pocket grant (active and revoked) |
| `g7_adminpockets_admins` | The in-game admin whitelist |
| `g7_adminpockets_logs` | The audit log |

---

## Step 5: Choose your inventory

Open `config.lua` and set your inventory. **g7_inventory is the default**, so if you use it you can skip this step.

```lua
Config.Inventory = 'g7_inventory' -- 'g7_inventory' | 'ox_inventory' | 'qs-inventory' | 'auto'
```

Then set the base carry weight (in kg) to match your inventory's normal player weight:

```lua
Config.BaseWeightKg = {
    ['g7_inventory'] = 30.0,
    ['ox_inventory'] = nil,   -- nil = read from the inventory:weight convar
    ['qs-inventory'] = 120.0,
}
```

> 💡 Bonuses are added **on top of** this number, so make sure it matches your inventory or players will end up with the wrong total.

---

## Step 6: Add the pocket items

Pocket items raise a player's carry weight just by holding them. Add these items to your inventory, then copy the item images into your inventory's image folder.

**g7_inventory / ox_inventory** — `data/items.lua`

```lua
['small_pouch'] = {
    label = 'Small Pouch',
    weight = 250,
    stack = false,
    close = true,
    description = 'A small pouch. +10kg carry weight while held.',
},
['medium_bag'] = {
    label = 'Medium Bag',
    weight = 1000,
    stack = false,
    close = true,
    description = 'A medium bag. +25kg carry weight while held.',
},
['large_backpack'] = {
    label = 'Large Backpack',
    weight = 2000,
    stack = false,
    close = true,
    description = 'A large backpack. +50kg carry weight while held.',
},
```

**qs-inventory** — `shared/items.lua`

```lua
['small_pouch'] = {
    name = 'small_pouch', label = 'Small Pouch', weight = 250, type = 'item',
    image = 'small_pouch.png', unique = true, useable = false, shouldClose = true,
    description = 'A small pouch. +10kg carry weight while held.',
},
['medium_bag'] = {
    name = 'medium_bag', label = 'Medium Bag', weight = 1000, type = 'item',
    image = 'medium_bag.png', unique = true, useable = false, shouldClose = true,
    description = 'A medium bag. +25kg carry weight while held.',
},
['large_backpack'] = {
    name = 'large_backpack', label = 'Large Backpack', weight = 2000, type = 'item',
    image = 'large_backpack.png', unique = true, useable = false, shouldClose = true,
    description = 'A large backpack. +50kg carry weight while held.',
},
```

| Inventory | Image folder |
|---|---|
| g7_inventory | `g7_inventory/web/images/` |
| ox_inventory | `ox_inventory/web/images/` |
| qs-inventory | `qs-inventory/html/images/` |

> 💡 Don't want pocket items? Set `Config.PocketItems.enabled = false` and skip this step.

---

## Step 7: Notifications (optional)

Pick how players are notified when they get or lose pocket space:

```lua
Config.Notify = 'ox_lib' -- 'ox_lib' | 'nui' | 'qb' | 'esx' | 'custom'
```

| Option | Uses |
|---|---|
| `ox_lib` | ox_lib notifications (default) |
| `nui` | Built-in G7 toasts that match the panel |
| `qb` | QBCore notify |
| `esx` | ESX notify |
| `custom` | Fires `Config.CustomNotifyEvent` so you can hook your own |

---

## Step 8: Start and test

1. Restart your server (or run `ensure g7_adminpockets`).
2. Check your server console for these three lines:

```
[g7_adminpockets] Framework detected: qbx
[g7_adminpockets] Inventory linked: g7_inventory
[g7_adminpockets] Ready — by G7 Development
```

3. Join the server and type **`/adminpocket`**. The panel should open.

✅ **You're done!**

---

## Commands

| Command | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/adminpocket` | Admins | Opens the admin panel |
| `/givepocket [id] [kg] [hours] [reason]` | Admins / console | Quick grant (leave hours empty or 0 for permanent) |
| `/revokepocket [grantId]` | Admins / console | Removes one grant |
| `/mypocket` | Everyone | Shows your own carry weight breakdown |

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| `No supported framework found` in console | Make sure your framework starts **before** `g7_adminpockets` in `server.cfg`. |
| `Inventory "..." is not started` in console | Check `Config.Inventory` matches your inventory and that it starts first. |
| `/adminpocket` says no permission | Add the ACE line from Step 3, or check your group is in `Config.AdminGroups`. |
| Total weight looks wrong | Set `Config.BaseWeightKg` to your inventory's real default player weight. |
| Pocket items don't add weight | Make sure the item names in your inventory match `Config.PocketItems.tiers` exactly. |
| Panel has no logo | Check `html/g7.png` exists and `Config.Brand.logo` is set to `g7.png`. |

Still stuck? Open a ticket in our [Discord](https://discord.gg/P6XQ4N6M95) and we'll help you out.

markdown:
# G7 Banking — Installation

This guide walks you through installing **G7 Banking** on your FiveM server. It takes about 10 minutes.

---

## Requirements

| Resource | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| [oxmysql](https://github.com/overextended/oxmysql) | ✅ Yes | Database connector |
| Framework | ✅ Yes | ESX, QBCore or QBox (auto-detected). ox_core and standalone are also supported |
| Inventory | ✅ Yes | ox_inventory, qb-inventory or g7-inventory |
| ox_target / qb-target | Optional | Without either, the script uses its own built-in **[E]** prompt |
| lb-phone | Optional | If running, a **G7 Bank** app is added to it automatically |

> **OneSync** must be enabled (it is on by default for most servers).

---

## Step 1 — Add the resource

1. Download **g7_banking** from your Keymaster / Tebex account.
2. Extract it into your resources folder, for example:

```
resources/[g7]/g7_banking
```

> ⚠️ Do **not** rename the folder. It must be called `g7_banking`.

---

## Step 2 — server.cfg

Start G7 Banking **after** oxmysql, your framework and your inventory:

```cfg
ensure oxmysql
ensure qb-core          # or es_extended / qbx_core
ensure ox_inventory     # or qb-inventory / g7-inventory
ensure ox_target        # optional
ensure g7_banking
```

### Admin permissions

```cfg
# Access to /bankadmin (branches, ATMs, players, credit, market, outages)
add_ace group.admin g7banking.admin allow

# Lets in-game admins use the g7outage command (the server console can always use it)
add_ace group.admin command.g7outage allow
```

> Players in the ESX / QBCore groups `admin`, `god` or `superadmin` can also open `/bankadmin`. You can change this in `Config.Admin`.

---

## Step 3 — Database

**Nothing to do.** All tables are created automatically on first start.

If you prefer to import manually, run `sql/install.sql` in your database before starting the resource.

---

## Step 4 — Card items

Players carry a physical bank card to use ATMs. Add the items to your inventory.

### ox_inventory

Add to `ox_inventory/data/items.lua`:

```lua
['g7_card'] = { label = 'G7 Card', weight = 5, stack = false, close = true, description = 'A G7 Bank payment card' },
['g7_card_standard'] = { label = 'G7 Standard Card', weight = 5, stack = false },
['g7_card_silver']   = { label = 'G7 Silver Card',   weight = 5, stack = false },
['g7_card_gold']     = { label = 'G7 Gold Card',     weight = 5, stack = false },
['g7_card_black']    = { label = 'G7 Black Card',    weight = 5, stack = false },
```

### qb-inventory

Add to `qb-core/shared/items.lua`:

```lua
g7_card          = { name = 'g7_card',          label = 'G7 Card',          weight = 5, type = 'item', image = 'g7_card.png',          unique = true, useable = false, shouldClose = true, description = 'A G7 Bank payment card' },
g7_card_standard = { name = 'g7_card_standard', label = 'G7 Standard Card', weight = 5, type = 'item', image = 'g7_card_standard.png', unique = true, useable = false, shouldClose = true, description = 'G7 debit card' },
g7_card_silver   = { name = 'g7_card_silver',   label = 'G7 Silver Card',   weight = 5, type = 'item', image = 'g7_card_silver.png',   unique = true, useable = false, shouldClose = true, description = 'G7 debit card' },
g7_card_gold     = { name = 'g7_card_gold',     label = 'G7 Gold Card',     weight = 5, type = 'item', image = 'g7_card_gold.png',     unique = true, useable = false, shouldClose = true, description = 'G7 debit card' },
g7_card_black    = { name = 'g7_card_black',    label = 'G7 Black Card',    weight = 5, type = 'item', image = 'g7_card_black.png',    unique = true, useable = false, shouldClose = true, description = 'G7 debit card' },
```

### g7-inventory

Add the same five items (`g7_card`, `g7_card_standard`, `g7_card_silver`, `g7_card_gold`, `g7_card_black`) to your g7-inventory item list, using the matching image names from Step 5. Set them as **unique / non-stackable**.

> Only `g7_card` is used in normal play. The card's number, owner and design are stored on the item. The four tier items are a fallback and are safe to add.

---

## Step 5 — Item images

Copy **every** PNG from:

```
g7_banking/images/inventory/
```

into your inventory's image folder:

| Inventory | Image folder |
|---|---|
| ox_inventory | `ox_inventory/web/images/` |
| qb-inventory | `qb-inventory/html/images/` |
| g7-inventory | g7-inventory's item image folder |

> Copy all of them. Each credit card and tier has its own design, and ox_inventory picks the right image automatically.

---

## Step 6 — Start the server

Restart your server (or run `ensure g7_banking`). In the server console you should see:

```
[g7_banking] framework: qb  inventory: ox_inventory
[g7_banking] database ready
[g7_banking] business accounts: internal
```

On first start, **8 bank branches** are created around the map with tellers and blips. You can move, rename or delete them in-game with `/bankadmin`.

---

## Step 7 — First-time setup in game

### Branches & ATMs
Open `/bankadmin` → **Branches** to add, move or remove branches. **Place in world** lets you position the teller with your camera:

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Mouse | Aim the placement |
| Scroll / Arrow keys | Rotate |
| Shift | Snap to your feet |
| E | Confirm |
| Backspace | Cancel |

All GTA map ATMs work automatically. Use **ATMs** in `/bankadmin` to place extra ones.

### Tune the ATM screen (recommended)
The bank UI appears on the ATM's real screen. To line it up perfectly:

1. Stand at an ATM and type `/atmcam`.
2. Drag the sliders until the outline fits the screen.
3. Press **Copy config** and paste it into `Config.ATM.models` in `config.lua`.

Repeat once for each ATM model on your map. If you'd rather skip this, set `Config.ATM.screenMode = 'framed'`.

---

## Supported inventories

| Inventory | Supported |
|---|---|
| ox_inventory | ✅ |
| qb-inventory | ✅ |
| g7-inventory | ✅ |

---

## Commands

| Command | Who | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/bank` | Everyone | Opens the bank (near a branch only, unless `commandAnywhere = true`) |
| `/bankphone` | Everyone | Opens the G7 phone banking app |
| `/bankadmin` | Admins | Admin panel |
| `/atmcam` | Everyone | ATM screen alignment tool (see Step 7) |
| `g7outage breach [min]` | Admins / console | Starts a data breach |
| `g7outage maint [min]` | Admins / console | Starts maintenance |
| `g7outage stop` | Admins / console | Ends any outage |

---

## Quick config

Everything lives in `config.lua`. The most common changes:

```lua
Config.BankName = 'G7 Bank'

Config.UI = {
    accent  = '#5B376A',   -- main colour, re-themes the whole UI
    accent2 = '#9D71B4',
    logo    = 'logo.png',  -- web/dist/logo.png
}

Config.Open = {
    command = 'bank',
    commandAnywhere = false,  -- true = /bank works anywhere
}

Config.PhysicalCards = {
    enabled = true,
    requireForATM = true,     -- false = ATMs work without carrying a card
    reissueFee = 250,
}
```

> **Your own logo:** replace `web/dist/logo.png` (and `logo-dark.png`, used on silver/gold/platinum cards).

---

## Troubleshooting

**The whole screen is black when the resource is running**
Clear your FiveM cache (`%localappdata%/FiveM/FiveM.app/data/cache`) and make sure you are on the latest version of G7 Banking.

**"You need your G7 card to use this ATM"**
The player has no card item. Cards are given when a player prints one at a branch teller (**Overview → Teller desk → Print card**), upgrades their debit tier, or is approved for a credit card. To let ATMs work without a card, set `Config.PhysicalCards.requireForATM = false`.

**Card items have no picture**
The PNGs from `images/inventory/` were not copied into your inventory's image folder (Step 5).

**/bank says I need to be at a branch**
This is intended. Visit a branch, or set `Config.Open.commandAnywhere = true`.

**/bankadmin says no permission**
Add the `add_ace` line from Step 2 and make sure your identifier is in `group.admin`.

**Branches don't appear**
Check the server console for `database ready`. If it's missing, oxmysql is not started before g7_banking.

**The ATM screen is misaligned**
Run `/atmcam` at that ATM (Step 7).

---

## Updating

1. Back up your `config.lua`.
2. Replace the `g7_banking` folder with the new version.
3. Put your `config.lua` back (check the changelog for any new options).
4. Restart the resource. Database changes are applied automatically.

title: G7 Illegal Weapon
description: Install G7 Illegal Weapon and configure its dependencies and permissions.
markdown:
# G7 Illegal Weapon — Installation

**g7_illegalweapon** by G7 Development. Placeable laser printers, a hacker laptop OS, a dark web shop, ATM wire payments and courier deliveries.

Setup takes about ten minutes. No SQL import is needed.

---

## 1. Requirements

| Requirement | Notes |
|---|---|
| FiveM server | A recent artifact with **OneSync** enabled. |
| [ox_lib](https://github.com/overextended/ox_lib) | **Required.** Used for callbacks, progress bars and skill checks. |
| A framework | `es_extended` (ESX), `qb-core` (QBCore) or `qbx_core` (Qbox). Auto-detected. |
| An inventory | `ox_inventory`, `qb-inventory` (also `ps-` / `lj-inventory`) or `qs-inventory`. Auto-detected. A custom inventory can be added (see [Custom inventory](#custom-inventory)). |
| A target system *(optional)* | `ox_target`, `qb-target` or `qtarget`. Without one, the script falls back to on-screen prompts (**E** and **G**). |
| A dispatch script *(optional)* | `ps-dispatch`, `cd_dispatch`, `qs-dispatch` or `core_dispatch`. Auto-detected. |

> **Note**
> `oxmysql` is not required. Printers and progression are stored in the resource's own key-value store and survive restarts.

---

## 2. Install the resource

1. Download and extract the resource.
2. Put the folder in your `resources` directory. **The folder name must be exactly `g7_illegalweapon`.**

```
resources/
└── [g7]/
    └── g7_illegalweapon/
        ├── fxmanifest.lua
        ├── config/
        ├── client/ server/ bridge/ shared/ locales/
        ├── web/
        ├── stream/
        └── install/
```

---

## 3. Add your props

The script spawns two custom props. Both are optional, and each has a fallback model if yours is missing or fails to stream.

| Prop | Model name | Config key |
|---|---|---|
| Laser printer | `g7devlaserprinter` | `Config.Printer.model` |
| Hacker computer *(optional)* | `g7devhackerpc` | `Config.Computer.model` |

1. Put your `.ydr`, `.ytd` and **`.ytyp`** files in `g7_illegalweapon/stream/`.
2. The `.ytyp` is required. A `.ydr` on its own will not create an object in game.
3. The archetype name in the `.ytyp` must match the model name above, or you must change the config to match.
4. If the model sits too high or low on surfaces, adjust `Config.Printer.zOffset`.

> **Note**
> If the custom model cannot load, the script uses `fallbackModel` and prints a debug line (turn on `Config.Debug`).

---

## 4. Register the items

Pick the file for your inventory from `install/` and paste its contents into your inventory's item list.

| Inventory | File | Paste into |
|---|---|---|
| ox_inventory | `install/ox_inventory_items.lua` | `ox_inventory/data/items.lua` |
| ox_inventory (weapons) | `install/ox_inventory_weapons.lua` | `ox_inventory/data/weapons.lua` |
| qb-inventory / ps / lj | `install/qb_items.lua` | `qb-core/shared/items.lua` |
| qs-inventory | `install/qs_items.lua` | `qs-inventory/shared/items.lua` |

### Item images

Copy everything in `install/images/` to your inventory's image folder.

| Inventory | Image folder |
|---|---|
| ox_inventory | `ox_inventory/web/images/` |
| qb-inventory | `qb-inventory/html/images/` |
| qs-inventory | `qs-inventory/html/images/` |

### Item list

| Item | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `g7_printer` | Deployable printer. |
| `g7_hacklaptop` | Hand-held laptop. Opens the hacker OS. |
| `g7_hackerpc` | Deployable workstation. Opens the same OS. |
| `g7_filament`, `g7_filament_cf` | Standard and carbon filament spools. |
| `g7_metal_scrap` | Print material. |
| `g7_nozzle`, `g7_printer_repair` | Printer maintenance. |
| `g7_vpn_dongle` | One-use VPN token. |
| `g7_blueprint_pistol`, `_compact`, `_smg` | Required in your inventory to print that weapon. |
| `g7_part_slide`, `_barrel`, `_trigger`, `_spring`, `_magazine`, `_frame` | Assembly parts. |
| `g7_ghost_frame_pistol`, `_compact`, `_smg` | Printed frames. Use one in your inventory to start assembly. |
| `WEAPON_GHOSTPISTOL`, `WEAPON_GHOSTCOMPACT`, `WEAPON_GHOSTSMG` | Placeholder weapons. Replace with yours (next section). |

> **Note**
> Usable items need no extra setup. The script registers them through your framework. On ox_inventory they use `consume = 0`, so the script, not the inventory, removes items.

---

## 5. Add your own weapons

Weapons are defined in `config/recipes.lua`. No other file needs editing.

1. Stream your weapon as usual (weapon metas, `data_file` entries, models).
2. Register the weapon in your inventory. On ox_inventory, add it to `weapons.lua`.
3. In `config/recipes.lua`, set `assembly.result.item` to your weapon name:

```lua
assembly = {
    result = { item = 'WEAPON_YOURWEAPON', count = 1, ammo = 0 },
    ...
}
```

To add a new recipe, copy an existing block and change `id`, `label`, `blueprint`, `materials`, `output` and `assembly`. If you add a new blueprint, printed frame or part, register it in your inventory (section 4) and add an image.

> **Note**
> Use uppercase weapon names in the config (`WEAPON_X`). They are converted to lowercase automatically for qb-inventory and qs-inventory.

---

## 6. Start the resource

Add this to `server.cfg`, **after** ox_lib, your framework, your inventory and your target script:

```cfg
ensure ox_lib
ensure es_extended        # or qb-core / qbx_core
ensure ox_inventory       # or qb-inventory / qs-inventory
ensure ox_target          # optional
ensure g7_illegalweapon

# Admin commands
add_ace group.admin g7illegal.admin allow
```

Restart the server. The console should print the detected framework and inventory:

```
[g7_illegalweapon] framework: qbox
[g7_illegalweapon] inventory: ox
```

---

## 7. Configure

All settings live in `config/`:

| File | Controls |
|---|---|
| `main.lua` | Framework, inventory, target, notify and dispatch overrides. Logo, accent color, money accounts, police jobs, progression, webhook logs. |
| `printer.lua` | Printer, computer and laptop props. Placement rules, limits, filament, wear and jams, tracker, VPN, police heat, ATM. |
| `recipes.lua` | Weapon recipes and assembly. |
| `shop.lua` | Dark web products, prices, stock and order expiry. |
| `delivery.lua` | Delivery tiers, courier appearance, claim window and meet points. |

### Logo and color

In `config/main.lua`:

```lua
Config.Theme = {
    brand  = 'G7 Development',
    logo   = 'img/logo.svg',   -- file inside web/img/
    accent = '#7C5CFF',        -- one hex value; the whole UI follows it
}
```

Replace `web/img/logo.svg` with your logo, or add a new file to `web/img/` and change `logo`. Square images work best.

### Delivery locations

The meet points in `config/delivery.lua` are examples. **Check each one in game** and replace them with your own:

```lua
{ label = 'Elysian Docks', coords = vec4(1242.3, -3257.5, 5.8, 270.0) },
```

### Language

Strings live in `locales/en.lua`. Copy it to `locales/xx.lua`, rename `Locales.en` to `Locales.xx`, translate it, and set `Config.Locale = 'xx'`.

---

## 8. Test checklist

Give yourself the items from the console, then check each step:

1. Use `g7_printer`. Place it, then pick it up again.
2. Give yourself `g7_filament`, `g7_metal_scrap` and `g7_blueprint_pistol`. Open the printer, load a spool and start a print.
3. Wait for the print, then collect the frame.
4. Give yourself the parts for the recipe, use the frame, and pass the skill check.
5. Use `g7_hacklaptop`. Add items to the cart and check out.
6. Walk to an ATM, choose **Wire Transfer**, and enter the account number from the laptop.
7. Wait for the courier and take the package.

---

## 9. Admin commands

Require the `g7illegal.admin` ACE (see section 6). They also work from the server console.

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/g7props` | List every deployed printer and computer. |
| `/g7removeprop <id>` | Delete one by id. |
| `/g7setxp <serverId> <xp>` | Set a player's progression XP. |

---

## 10. Custom framework or inventory

### Custom inventory

Set `Config.Inventory = 'custom'` and fill in the `impl.custom` block in `bridge/server/inventory.lua`. Implement five functions:

```lua
Count(src, item)              -- number owned
Add(src, item, count, meta)   -- true on success
Remove(src, item, count)      -- true on success
CanCarry(src, item, count)    -- true if it fits
GetMeta(src, item)            -- metadata table of the first matching stack
```

### Custom framework

Set `Config.Framework = 'custom'` and implement the same functions in `bridge/server/framework.lua`. For item use, call this when your system uses an item:

```lua
exports['g7_illegalweapon']:UseItem(source, 'g7_printer')
```

### Custom dispatch

Set `Config.Dispatch = 'custom'` and fill in `Config.CustomDispatch` in `config/printer.lua`.

---

## 11. Troubleshooting

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| Console says `inventory: custom` or `framework: custom` | The script was started before your inventory or framework. Fix the `ensure` order, or force the value in `config/main.lua`. |
| Item does nothing when used | The item is not registered, or its name is misspelled. Compare with `install/` and restart the inventory. |
| Printer is a different model | The custom prop did not load, so the fallback is in use. Check the `.ytyp` and the archetype name. |
| Printer floats or sinks | Adjust `Config.Printer.zOffset`. |
| Weapon is not received after assembly | The `result.item` name is not registered in your inventory. |
| No ATM option | The option only appears if you have an unpaid order. Set `Config.ATM.showOnlyWithOrder = false` to always show it. |
| No target prompts | Your target script must start before this one. Without a target script, use **E** and **G** prompts. |
| Dispatch alerts do nothing | Check that the dispatch script name matches, or use `custom`. Alerts depend on your dispatch version. |
| Courier does not appear | Check the meet point coordinates. The courier spawns when you are within about 120 m. |
| Need more detail | Set `Config.Debug = true` and read the server and F8 consoles. |

---

## 12. Updating

1. Back up your `config/` folder and `web/img/`.
2. Replace the resource files.
3. Restore your config and logo, and compare against the new config for added options.
4. Restart the resource. Printers are kept.

---

## Support

For support, contact **G7 Development**.

# Troubleshooting Center

Use this page to collect useful details before changing a resource. The correct fix depends on the specific G7 resource, framework, inventory, and error.

## Resource does not start

1. Read the first error in the server console; later errors may be consequences of the first one.
2. Confirm the resource folder name matches the name used in `server.cfg`.
3. Check that required dependencies are installed and started before the resource.
4. Confirm the resource files were extracted into the expected folder and that `fxmanifest.lua` is present.
5. Check the resource's own installation guide for its supported framework and requirements.

## Script starts but a feature does not work

- Confirm the correct framework and inventory options are selected in the resource configuration, where applicable.
- Check that item names, exports, event names, and resource start order match the guide.
- If the guide includes SQL, confirm it was imported into the correct database.
- Reproduce the issue and capture the exact client or server console message.

## UI or NUI issues

- Check the F8 console and server console for errors.
- Verify the resource's `ui_page` and included files are present as packaged.
- Test after a full resource restart and a browser cache refresh if the UI appears outdated.

## What to send support

Include the G7 resource name and version, framework, inventory, relevant dependencies, what you expected, what happened, and the exact error text. Attach a short clip or screenshot if it helps. **Never share server keys, passwords, tokens, or other credentials.**

[Contact G7 Development support](https://discord.gg/P6XQ4N6M95).

markdown:
# G7 Advanced Rolling — Installation

## Requirements
- `ox_lib`
- `oxmysql`
- A framework (Qbox, QBCore or ESX) and supported inventory (g7_inventory, ox_inventory, qs-inventory, qb-inventory / ps / lj, ESX default)
- `g7_vapesystem` (optional, for live theme sync)

## Step 1 — Add the resource
Drop `g7_advancedrolling` into your resources folder.

## Step 2 — Install the items
Add the items for your inventory from `install/`:

| Inventory | File | Where |
|---|---|---|
| g7_inventory / ox_inventory | `items_ox_g7_inventory.lua` | `data/items.lua` |
| qb-inventory / ps / lj | `items_qb_core.lua` | `qb-core/shared/items.lua` |
| qs-inventory | `items_qs_inventory.lua` | `qs-inventory/shared/items.lua` |
| ESX default inventory | `items_esx.sql` | Run in your database |

If your server already has a lighter item, skip `lighter` and set `Config.Lighter.item` to your item name.

## Step 3 — Install the images
Copy `install/images/*` into your inventory image folder:
- ox / g7: `web/images`
- qb: `html/images`
- qs: `html/images`

## Step 4 — server.cfg
```cfg
ensure ox_lib
ensure oxmysql
# your framework + inventory here
ensure g7_advancedrolling
```

## Step 5 — Database
Nothing to do. The `g7_rolling_stats` table is created automatically on first start.

## Step 6 — Full restart
Do a **full server restart** the first time (not just `restart g7_advancedrolling`) so the streamed smoke particle (`g7rollsmoke.ypt`), props and animation load.

## Step 7 — Configure
- **Discord logs:** `server/sv_config.lua`
- **Rolling mode:** `Config.Rolling.mode = 'tray'` (3D tray) or `'classic'`
- **UI:** `Config.UI.style = 'g7'` or `'ox_lib'`
- **Theme:** `Config.Theme` (`g7`, `frost`, `toxic`, `ember`, `gold`, `mono` or `'custom'`); set `syncWithVape = true` to follow g7_vapesystem
- **Image path:** if images aren't in the default folder, set `Config.UI.images`, e.g. `'nui://g7_inventory/web/images/%s.png'`
- **Stress relief:** `Config.Smoking.stress = 'auto'` uses `hud:server:RelieveStress` (QB/Qbox) or `esx_status` (ESX)
- **Weaker PCs:** `Config.Tray.quality = 'low'`

## Step 8 — Test
1. Give yourself a strain (e.g. `weed_og_kush`), a `weed_grinder`, a wrap (e.g. `wrap_original`) and a `lighter`.
2. Use the weed to open the rolling tray.
3. Run `/rollstats` and `/strains` to confirm stats save.
4. Admins can use `/bluntgrip` to line up the blunt in the hand.

# G7 Beauty — Installation

## Requirements

- **ox_lib** and **oxmysql**
- **OneSync** turned on
- **Framework:** Qbox, QBCore or ESX (detected automatically)
- **Inventory:** g7_inventory, ox_inventory, qs-inventory, qb-inventory or the ESX default (detected automatically)
- **Target:** ox_target or qb-target (detected automatically)
- **Game build 2699 or newer.** Add this to your `server.cfg`:

  ```cfg
  set sv_enforceGameBuild 3095
  ```

## 1. Add the resource

1. Put the `g7_beauty` folder in your `resources` folder.
2. In `server.cfg`, start it **after** your framework, inventory, target, ox_lib and oxmysql:

   ```cfg
   ensure g7_beauty
   ```

## 2. Database

Nothing to do. The tables are created automatically the first time the script starts. If you'd rather create them yourself, run `sql/install.sql`.

## 3. Items

Add the items to your inventory using the matching file in the `install` folder, and copy the item images from `install/images/` into your inventory's images folder.

| Inventory | Item file | Images go in |
|---|---|---|
| g7_inventory / ox_inventory | `install/ox_items.lua` | your inventory's `web/images/` folder |
| qb-inventory (and ps / lj) | `install/qb_items.lua` | `qb-inventory/html/images/` |
| qs-inventory | `install/qs_items.lua` | `qs-inventory/html/images/` |
| ESX default | `install/esx_items.sql` | your inventory's images folder |

Press-on nails need an inventory that supports item metadata, so they turn off automatically on the ESX default inventory.

## 4. Jobs

The script uses two jobs:

- `nailtech` for nails
- `makeupartist` for makeup and the Lash Bar

Copy the job setup for your framework from `install/jobs.md` (Qbox, QBCore and ESX examples are included). If you want different job names, change them in `Config.Services` in `config.lua`.

## 5. Salon locations

Open `config.lua` and set your salon locations under `Config.Salons`: the nail stations, lash beds, vanities, kiosk and boss menu spot. The example coordinates are only placeholders, so replace them with the spots in your MLO.

To grab a position, turn on `Config.Debug`, stand where the chair or spot should be and type `/beautypos`. The position is copied to your clipboard.

## 6. Admin permission (for vanities)

To let admins manage any placed vanity, add this to `server.cfg`:

```cfg
add_ace group.admin g7beauty.admin allow
```

## 7. Image uploads (optional)

To let players upload their own images onto nails, add **one** of these to `server.cfg` (never to the config):

```cfg
set g7_beauty_fivemanage "YOUR_FIVEMANAGE_KEY"
```

Or:

```cfg
set g7_beauty_webhook "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."
```

FiveManage is recommended, because Discord image links expire after about a day and the image disappears from the nails.

## 8. Before going live

In `config.lua`:

- Set `Config.Debug = false`.
- Pick your theme with `Config.UI.theme`: `'light'` (Flower Wall) or `'dark'` (Pink Jungle Neon).
- Look through the shop prices (`Config.Shop`), refill settings (`Config.Refill`) and nail wear settings (`Config.Wear`).

Then restart the resource and you're done.

---

## Player commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/mynails` | Do your own nails (needs a Nail Kit) |
| `/mymakeup` | Do your own makeup |
| `/mylashes` | Do your own lashes (needs tweezers, glue and lashes) |
| `/nails` | Look at your nails |
| `/shownails` | Show your nails off to nearby players |
| `/nailcheck` | See if any nails are broken or worn |
| `/standup` | Stand up from a salon seat or vanity (BACKSPACE or X also work) |
| `/beautystats` | Your beauty job level, clients and earnings |

## Exports

Other scripts can show a G7 Beauty notification:

```lua
exports.g7_beauty:Notify('Your set is ready', 'success', 5000)
```

Drop `g7_cinestudio` into your resources folder.

# your framework here

```

## Step 4 — Set access
Open `config.lua` and choose who can use it: everyone, ACE, staff groups or jobs (e.g. a news job). For ACE, set `Config.Access.Ace.Enabled = true` and add:

add_ace group.admin g7.cinestudio.use allow
add_ace group.vip g7.cinestudio.use allow

add_ace group.admin g7.cinestudio.staff allow
```

1. Add the item from `install/` for your inventory (g7/ox, Qbox, qb, qs or ESX SQL).

3. Set `Config.Item.Enabled = true` (and `RequiredForCommand = true` if `/cine` should need the item).

## Step 6 — Storage (optional)

- Limits and theme in `config.lua`
- Controls in `Config.Controls` (update `Config.KeyLabels` to match if changed)
- Use `Config.Clean.OnHide` / `OnShow` to hide your own HUD resources during clean capture

## Step 8 — Test
1. Restart the server.
2. Type `/cine`.
3. Press **H** for clean capture and **G** for pose mode.

> Depth of field needs **Post FX: High/Ultra** and **DOF** turned on in GTA graphics settings.

ensure ox_lib

## Step 2 — server.cfg
Add these **after** oxmysql, your framework and your inventory:
```cfg
ensure g7_vipfemale
add_ace group.admin vipfemale.admin allow
```

## Step 3 — Install the items
Add the items for your inventory from `install/`:

| Inventory | File |
|---|---|
| g7_inventory, ox_inventory (Qbox) | `install/items_ox.lua` |
| qb-inventory, lj-inventory, ps-inventory | `install/items_qb.lua` |

## Step 4 — Install the images

## Step 5 — Add your logo
Replace `web/img/g7.png` with your logo (square PNG, 512×512 looks best).

## Step 6 — Database
Nothing to do. Tables are created automatically.

## Step 7 — Set who can open it
In `config.lua`, set `Config.Access.mode`:
- `female` — saved character gender
- `discord` — one of the Discord roles in `config_server.lua`
- `either` / `both`
- `open` — everyone

Staff can always open it (`Config.Access.staffBypass`).

## Step 8 — Server config (`config_server.lua`)
- Discord bot token and roles (if using Discord access or the Closet role lock)
- Discord webhooks
- Tebex packages (see Step 9)

## Step 9 — Tebex (optional)
1. List packages under `ServerConfig.Tebex.packages` (each has a key, label and reward).
2. In Tebex, give the package this server command (the last word must match a package key):
   ```
   vipfemale_tebex {transaction} vip_month
   ```
3. Optional chargeback command: `vipfemale_tebex_revoke {transaction}`
4. Players claim in **Rewards → Store Claim** with their `tbx-…` transaction ID.

## Step 10 — Hook up your other resources
Check `editable/client.lua` and `editable/server.lua`. Vehicle keys, fuel, clothing/appearance and dispatch are auto-detected; add your own resource there if it isn't listed.
- **Dirty money:** drug sales pay `black_money` by default. Set `Config.Drug.sell.account = 'cash'` if you don't use dirty money.
- **Closet:** auto-detects your appearance system, or set `Config.Closet.system = 'custom'`.

## Step 11 — Test
1. Restart the server.
2. Type `/vipfemale`.
3. If you can't open it, use `/vipfemale_allow [id]` or check `Config.Access.mode`.
